definition.title: Refer to others and unspecified people
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

steps.title: Refer to others and unspecified people

blocks.text: 咱们 includes the speaker and the person being addressed. The people included depend on who is speaking to whom; it does not automatically name the same group in every conversation. 别人 means other people; 别的 replaces a recoverable item; 其他 modifies the remaining members. 怎样 asks how; 谁…都 makes a free choice.
